title: Lament for the Departed Soul (U Khun Blei Khlad Noh)
cultural_context: Sacred funeral lament accompanying the soul back across the bridge toward the council of the ancestors and God, from 'Ki Khasi Poems'.

khasi: Me la khlad noh, ko khun u Blei,
Na kane ka pyrthei ba marwei;
Me la leit sha dwar ka jingshai,
Sha khet ba buh u Nongthaw;
Ka sharati ka rwai ka sur pangnud,
Ki ummat ki jaw ha ka dpei;
Ba me la ioh ka jingsuk ba neh.
english: You have departed, O child of God,
You have journeyed to the gate of light,
Unto the throne established by the Creator;
The Sharati flute mourns in heartbreaking tones,
Tears fall beside the silent hearth;
That you have attained everlasting peace.

khasi: Sha khet ki kpa tymmen me kiew,
Ban shong lang ha khet u Blei;
Ki mawbynna kin ieng ha ka ri,
Ban pynsah ia la ka nam;
Thiah suk ha pneh u Blei;
Haduh ba ngin da ia shem biang
Ha ka shnong ba phyrnai junom.
english: Unto the council of the ancestors you ascend,
Memorial monoliths shall stand in the land,
Rest peacefully in the bosom of God;
In that radiant city beyond all time.

vocabulary.khlad noh: depart / pass away to the ancestors
